title: MarketBoard
description: A league's games on the prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket US, Novig): each game matched across the venues that list it, its live state when a venue reports one, and every venue's price for the same contracts, with the cheapest all-in. Served by the markets service.

updated_at.description: When the board was last rebuilt.

venues.description: How each venue's last poll went.

games.description: Live games first, then by kick-off.

error.description: Why it failed, if it did.

updated_at.description: When its prices were last read.

games.description: How many of the league's games it lists.

color.description: The team's colour, as #rrggbb, if a venue gives one.

GameState.title: GameState
GameState.description: From the venues: live once any says so, ended once any says so.

Listing.title: Listing
Listing.description: A venue's event for the game.

url.description: The event's page on the venue.

ContractKind.title: ContractKind
ContractKind.description: total: over line goals in regulation (90 minutes plus stoppage, no extra time or penalties). result: the outcome after regulation.

Outcome.title: Outcome
Outcome.description: What a Yes pays on: over the line (total), or a home win, a draw or an away win (result).

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: One venue's price to buy Yes, per contract that pays $1. Prices are dollars from 0 to 1.

market_id.description: The venue's market (Kalshi ticker, Polymarket slug, Novig market id).

bid.description: Best price someone will pay for Yes.

ask.description: Best price to buy Yes now.

fee.description: The taker fee per contract at the ask, by the venue's schedule (0 when it charges none, e.g. Novig before kick-off).

all_in.description: ask + fee: what one contract costs.

Contract.title: Contract
Contract.description: One contract, priced on every venue that lists it.

key.description: Stable within the game, e.g. total-over-2.5 or result-draw.

line.description: For total: the goals line, e.g. 2.5.

best.description: The venue with the lowest all-in price that has contracts at its ask, if any.

implied.description: The best all-in price as a probability: what the market says, after fees.

kickoff_estimated.description: Whether kickoff is estimated: Kalshi gives no kick-off time, so a game only Kalshi lists has one worked out from its markets' close.

clock.description: The venue's match clock, e.g. 63' or HT.
